OUR LITTLE CLASSROOMS

Nature Club

There is a whole world just outside.

Make a sound map

Ages 3–1215 min

Listen from one safe spot and draw a map of the sounds around you.

Make a leaf rubbing

Ages 3–815 min

Turn fallen leaves into crayon rubbings, compare their textures and build leaf creatures from your own art.

What this room is for

Nature Club slows the day down: one safe listening spot for a sound map, a handful of fallen leaves for rubbings, textures to compare and leaf creatures to build. You stay in one place together, and the outside world does the entertaining.

How one session runs

Choose your spot first (a bench, a patch of grass, an open window on a rainy day), sit still for a few minutes, then draw or rub what you notice. There is no right number of sounds or leaves — the listening diary and compare-two-leaves sheets give the walk a gentle finish without turning it into a lesson.
